From the arcade

Memory Match

Sixteen cards, eight pairs. Remember what you have seen.

Play Memory Match →

How to play

  1. Click two different cards to reveal their symbols. A matching pair stays face up.
  2. If they do not match, take a moment to remember them. Click “Turn cards over” before choosing again.
  3. Find all eight pairs. Try to finish in fewer turns; eight turns is a perfect round.
  4. “New deal” cycles through three prepared arrangements. Your best completed round stays visible until you leave or reload this page.

No countdown, no auto-flipping cards, and no typing. The whole game waits for your next click.
